name: ringer_statues
_: STATUES, Stephen's idea (KEEPSIES_BUILD_PLAN.md step 9): four statues placed by the AI's seeded rule for both owners, then whole Rookie matches through the game's own Ringer. A match with four statues completes; no marble ever stands inside a Loaf; a straight 5 m/s shot at a Loaf stops on the near side; a 2 m/s shot through an Arch passes under it untouched; the same statue record replays to the same match. Step 10: when Dusty's own Loaf stands between his shooter and the cross he spends the turn moving it, at most two feet, clear of every marble, and the turn passes; a statue is never moved onto a marble.

asserts.id: a match with four statues completes
no marble ever passes through a Loaf
a 5 m/s shot at a Loaf stops on the near side
a marble shot through an Arch passes under it
the same statue record replays to the same match
the AI moves its own statue out of its best shot
and the move is at most two feet
and the moved statue touches no marble
and the move spends the turn
